name: V-Dem Liberal Democracy Index

govt_response.title: Government/MEA reaction to democracy indices (V-Dem, Freedom House, EIU) in 2021
govt_response.summary: Per press reports, the MEA considered backing an Indian think-tank's own democracy report and freedom index in response to 2021 downgrades. See also BoomLive on the Chief Election Commissioner saying flawed rankings harm democracy: https://www.boomlive.in/explainers/after-v-dem-report-on-india-cec-says-flawed-rankings-harming-democracy-21306. Exact MEA rejection text not retrieved.

methodology_note: Values are the Our World in Data series of V-Dem's latest dataset vintage; V-Dem revises historical values each release, so earlier editions published different figures. 'year' is the data year (the report is published the following March). V-Dem's 2021 report (covering 2020) reclassified India from 'electoral democracy' to 'electoral autocracy'; the Democracy Report 2024 said India remained an electoral autocracy at the end of 2023 (Scroll). V-Dem's classification (Regimes of the World) is a separate judgement from the LDI score. The Indian government disputes such indices' methodologies.
